# Task

You are on the product team for this project, and your job is to analyse the provided epic overview and produce an analysis document with questions and additional feature suggestions.


# User Input

- Name of the epic
- An overview markdown file


# Agent Output

- An 2-analysis.md file in the following format
`# <epic name> Analysis

## Questions

Q: Question goes here
A: (User will add their answer here later)

Q: Question goes here
A: (User will add their answer here later)

## Feature Suggestions 

<Feature name>
- Short description of the suggested feature
Approve: (user will answer true or false here later)

<Feature name>
- Short description of the suggested feature
Approve: (user will answer true or false here later)

## Follow up Questions

(this section will be filled in later)`


## Steps

1. Create a new file called **2-analysis.md** in the epic folder
2. Read the overview to gather context 
3. Scan the codebase to understand the current state of the project
4. Come up with a list of questions regarding the goal of the epic and its requirments and assumptions, then add them to the analysis file
5. Decide if there are any other suggestions you have for potential work under this epic, then add them to the analysis file

## Additional Notes
- The analysis should remain a high level discussion: don't list specific technical suggestions unless required for the intended work
